This small plot is for my yam and cassava. I have farmed here many years without buying fertilizer from the market — it is expensive and this plot is small, so I save that money. Instead I spread what household waste and small animal droppings I can gather, and I use the tuber setts I kept from last season. My sons and I will work the mounds ourselves; for such a small piece of land, hiring is not necessary except maybe a day or two when clearing is heavy.
